annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on machinery and amending Directive 95/16/EC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on machinery and amending Directive 95/16/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 154 E
annotation.summary_en: 2001 Commission proposal (COM(2000) 899) recasting the EU Machinery Directive 98/37/EC. It sets essential health and safety requirements for machinery design, conformity assessment procedures, CE marking, harmonised standards, market surveillance and notified bodies. Robots are mentioned only incidentally (training console); no AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recasts Directive 98/37/EC and amends lifts Directive 95/16/EC
Manufacturers must perform risk analysis and meet Annex I essential health and safety requirements
Conformity assessment by risk category, with notified bodies for Annex IV machinery
CE marking and EC declaration of conformity give presumption of conformity; harmonised standards non-binding
Member States run market surveillance, safeguard clauses and impose effective penalties
